experiment: policy comparison on CrisisMMD real disaster data

dataset_provenance.cite: F. Alam, F. Ofli, M. Imran, CrisisMMD: multimodal Twitter datasets from natural disasters, in: Proc. 12th Int. AAAI Conf. Web and Social Media, 2018.
dataset_provenance.label: image_damage, three classes: severe_damage, mild_damage, little_or_no_damage
dataset_provenance.text_representation: CLIP text embedding reduced by PCA to 8 components, PCA fitted on training events only
dataset_provenance.arrival_times: recovered from the Twitter snowflake identifier; real, not synthesised
dataset_provenance.image_representation: CLIP image embedding reduced by PCA to 10 components, PCA fitted on training events only
dataset_provenance.payload_sizes: real: image byte sizes are the files on disk, text byte sizes are the UTF-8 length of the tweet. Neither is assumed.
not_modelled: no sensor modality exists in CrisisMMD; the workload has two modalities
no geolocation in the annotations; spatial admissibility degrades to event identity
no severity field independent of the label; severity is held constant

sensor_modality: absent in CrisisMMD; marked permanently unavailable
severity: held constant; no field independent of the label exists
spatial_admissibility: degrades to event identity; no geolocation in the annotations
